To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the fluorination treatment of YBa 3 Cu 4 O x and Bi 4 Cu 4 O y ceramics is an effective way to protect them from the environmental conditions, and that the fluorine treatment improves their superconducting properties.

low-temperature fluorine treatments improve the shielding effect of superconducting YBa 2Cu 3 O 6.95 and Bi 1.6Pb 0.4Sr 2Ca 2Cu 4O 16.4 samples, and the improvement is more important when the fluorination is done at low temperatures.

low-temperature fluorine gas treatment of superconducting YBCO and Bi2212 oxides leads to the formation of a protective oxyfluoride surface layer that enhances the superconducting performance of these materials, in terms of shielding effect and critical current density.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new technology for the production of superconductors, in order to obtain materials with improved superconducting characteristics.
the development of a new method of protection of the high-T c superconductors against the action of water vapour and the gas exchange with the environment.
the influence of fluorine gas treatment on the characteristics of the superconducting oxycarbonate YBa 2 (Cu 0.9 Zn 0.1 ) 3 O 5.8.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

fluorination is an efficient process for the stabilization of superconducting YBa 2 CU 3 O 6.9−δ and Bi 4(Ca, SR) 6Cu 4O 16+δ ceramics against moisture and gas exchange, and that the superconducting transition temperature T c is increased in YBa 2CU 3O 7−δ and decreased in Bi 4(CA, SR) 4Cu 4O16+ δ.
fluorination is an interesting method for the protection of superconducting ceramics against moisture and gas exchanges.
the fluorination treatment of YBa 1.9 Ca 0.1 Cu 3 O y and Bi 4.2 Sr 1.8 Cu 2.2 O x samples is an effective method to improve the shielding effect of these materials.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the fluorine treatments are very effective in the improvement of the superconducting performance.
fluorine treatments at low temperature can improve superconducting properties and can be a good alternative to protect YBa 2 CU 3 O 6.9 ceramics against degradation.
the fluorination treatment is a useful technique for improving the stability of superconductors in a wet environment.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the fluorination process is an efficient way to improve the superconducting characteristics of YBCO ceramics.
low temperature fluorination can be used to enhance the superconducting characteristics of the materials.
low-temperature fluorine treatment of the surface of YBa2Cu 3 O 6.9 and Bi 2.2 Sr 1.8 Ca 0.8 Cu 2 O 9.2 ceramics is an effective method of improving the superconducting performance of these oxides.
